products.geographic_scope: International journeys to destinations outside Australia. You must select covered destinations (transit stops under 48 hours automatically included). Medical treatment in Australia not covered unless on an international cruise with Cruise add-on. No cover for cruises staying only in Australian waters.
products.eligibility_rules: Must live in Australia permanently; be eligible for Medicare; travel to a destination outside Australia; return to Australia after each journey; not have been refused cover/claim declined/policy cancelled or voided due to fraud; have access to an email address. You must check Smartraveller advisories before purchase and before travel; cover is affected by ‘Do not travel’/‘Reconsider your need to travel’ advisories.
products.age_eligibility_notes: Personal Accident benefits apply only for ages 16–80 at policy start. Relevant person claims are not available if the relevant person is over 85 before the date insurance was issued. Dependent children covered if under 21 and not in full-time employment. Loss of Income benefit has a 30-day waiting period after planned return and pays for up to 13 weeks.

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless stated otherwise: limits apply per person per journey. Many sub-limits apply per item/pair/set and/or have aggregate caps per person. On an annual policy, limits reset for each new journey.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: No automatic cover for any pre-existing medical conditions. Cover may be offered if you complete a medical assessment, disclose all diagnosed conditions/changes, and pay any extra premium; otherwise those conditions are excluded. Undiagnosed symptoms are not covered. Pregnancy complications in the last 3 years are treated as pre-existing and require assessment for cover.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Automatic cover for pregnancy-related claims up to 24 weeks’ gestation (single or multiple, including fertility treatment) if no prior complications before purchase. Covers overseas childbirth up to 23 weeks 6 days and neonatal care until return to Australia. No cover after 24 weeks or for common pregnancy symptoms. Pregnancy complications are treated as pre-existing and require assessment for potential cover.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Limited cover for ‘relevant person’ events: death; hospital admission for non‑elective treatment (or doctor recommendation); admission to or recommendation for end‑stage palliative care; diagnosis of terminal condition or one requiring radiotherapy/chemotherapy. Relevant person must be under 85 before insurance was issued. Sub-limit $2,500 per person applies in D.2 and D.3.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers only the rental vehicle excess charged by a licensed rental company. Vehicle must be a standard motor vehicle or motorhome up to 8 seats, or (if add‑on selected) a moped/motorbike ≤200cc (≤15kW electric). Driver must be named on your Certificate of Insurance and rental agreement, comply with licence and road laws; no off‑road driving; not a substitute for rental vehicle insurance; no Personal Liability cover for vehicle use.
products.luggage_conditions: Strict unattended property rules. No cover for items left unattended in public places; in vehicles (varies by item and time of day); or in unlocked premises. Electronics/cameras not covered if in checked baggage or left unattended with transport providers; jewellery/watches must be carried on person on transport and stored in safes/lockers in accommodation. Proof of journey, prompt police/authority reports, service‑provider claims required. IMEI blocking proof required for lost/stolen mobile phones. Depreciation applies to unspecified items and to specified items without full proof.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: You must check Smartraveller advisories when buying and before travel. If DFAT ‘Do not travel’ or ‘Reconsider your need to travel’ applies to a whole country or a part of it, you won’t be covered for related events in that area. If advisories change after purchase or between journeys, limited cover may apply under D.2/D.3 to avoid the destination with a new advisory.
products.claims_process_summary: Make claims online at www.scti.com.au/claims. Notify as soon as possible. Keep and provide receipts, medical reports and prescriptions. Report theft/loss to police/authority promptly and obtain written report; for phones, provide IMEI blocking proof. Seek refunds/credits from service providers; we pay the difference. For major medical events/hospitalisation/surgery or when costs expected to exceed $2,000, contact Southern Cross Emergency Assistance for prior approval.
products.emergency_assistance_details: Southern Cross Emergency Assistance: +61 2 9191 1180 (24/7). Prior approval required if admitted to hospital, need surgery, or expect medical expenses over $2,000.
products.premium_factors: Premium depends on maximum trip duration selected; number/ages of adults, children and non‑dependent children; destinations; chosen excess; selected cancellation cover amount; specified items; optional covers (ski/snowboard; moped/motorbike; cruise); pre‑existing medical cover; government duties/taxes.
